title: 第10章 怪物第11章 出大事了
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
“爸爸就是他，就是他，今天打我的人打残豹子叔叔的人就是他。”
看到陈锋后，郭龙立马站了起来用手指着陈锋喊道，郭龙是万万没想到啊万万没想到，陈锋竟敢一个人来他家里，这是疯了吗，他是不怕死吗，不知道五口堂是如何强大吗。
“哦，你是怎么进来的？外面那些人呢？”
而郭啸天则有些吃惊，他知道自己外面可是有20多个巡逻的保镖的，如果陈锋硬闯的话自然是会惊动保镖的，为什么一点动静都没。
“难道？”
郭啸天忽然有了不祥的预感。
“没错，外面的那些狗都被我干掉了，你看。”
陈锋微微一笑，手一动光滑的地板上直接多出来了20多个肉乎乎的血淋淋的东西，而郭啸天一看顿时倒吸一口气，因为地板上的是20颗血淋淋的心脏，心脏还在跳动。
原来刚才陈锋在进来的时候就被那些巡逻的五口堂的小弟发现了，陈锋没和他们废话直接用剑气击杀了他们，还将他们的心脏取了出来。
陈锋知道这些黑帮人员都不是好东西，不知道做了多少坏事，所以下手自然也不会客气的。
“天啊！”
别墅大厅里，看到地上的心脏，郭龙吓得不行，他感觉胃里一阵翻江倒海，他转身直接呕吐起来了，现场里面满是酸臭味道。
看到地上的一堆呕吐物，闻到臭烘烘的味道，陈锋嫌弃的别过了头，心想这样的废物还是黑二代，还到处惹事生非。
虽然郭龙吐了，但是郭啸天和他手下那些精锐倒是还好，当然虽然他们没有呕吐，但是他们的脸色还是有了变化。
陈锋，太狠了。
一进来就杀了那么多五口堂小弟。，还取出他们的心脏，这手段果然狠辣，比他们都狠。
“兄弟，看的出来你应该的武者，这样吧干脆你加入我们五口堂如何，只要你加入的话你和我们的恩怨一笔勾销，然后每个月我给你三千万俸禄如何？”
不过郭啸天深吸一口气后，忽然他脸上露出了笑容，他目光炯炯的看着陈锋。
自然郭啸天也是爱财之人，他看到陈锋这么厉害不声不响的干掉了他的20个手下，如此厉害的人物自然是武者了，起码也到了内劲小成。
这样的人哪怕是硕大的五口堂里也是顶尖的存在。

所以郭啸天想要拉拢陈锋，为他做事。
要知道五口堂虽然是一个集团，不过是有五个堂主的，五个堂主谁都不服气谁，而郭啸天身为第五分堂的堂主，其实是五个分堂最弱的存在。
如果得到了陈锋，他的第五分堂自然是势力壮大了。
“爸爸，你疯了，他是我们的仇人。”
听到爸爸要拉拢陈锋，郭龙气坏了，觉得爸爸疯了，对郭龙而言陈锋是他的仇人，陈锋一定是要死的，哪怕陈锋很厉害也要死。
“闭嘴。”
不过郭啸天只是瞪了儿子一眼，然后期盼的看着陈锋。
“哦，想要我加入你们也不是不行，不过我有一个条件。”
陈锋笑嘻嘻的道。
“哦，什么条件，只要我能办到的一定办到，是要加钱还是要美女，放心我们都有。”
看到陈锋提条件，郭啸天放心了许多，在他眼里男人无非是就是图财和图色，只要有弱点就好拿捏。
如果求财，他们五口堂是楚州最大的帮派，每年利润上百个亿，自然是不差钱的。
图色的话更加容易了，他们五口堂光在楚州就有上百家夜场，里面的美女加起来怕是有几十万了，找几个极品伺候陈锋实在太容易了。
“呵呵，郭堂主，你也知道你儿子得罪了我，他欺负我的小姑妈，而我和小姑妈感情深厚，这样吧你如果阉掉你儿子，我就加入你们如何。”
陈锋笑嘻嘻的道，忽然丢给了郭啸天一把刀子，刀子落在了郭啸天脚下。
听到陈锋的话，看到地上的刀子，郭啸天惊呆了，郭龙惊呆了，在场的所有的人都惊呆了。
“你是在逗我吗？我怎么可能阉掉自己儿子，我让自己绝后吗？”
郭啸天的脸顿时阴沉了下来，他知道陈锋压根就是在耍他，谁会阉掉自己儿子让自己断子绝孙呢。
content_en:
"Dad is him, it's him. The person who beat me today and the person who maimed Uncle Leopard are him."
After seeing Chen Feng, Guo Long immediately stood up and pointed at Chen Feng and shouted, Guo Long never expected that Chen Feng would dare to come to his house alone. Is this crazy? Isn't he afraid of death? I don't know how powerful Wukoutang is.
"Oh, how did you get in? Where are those people outside?"
Guo Xiaotian was a little surprised. He knew that there were more than 20 bodyguards patrolling outside. If Chen Feng forced his way in, he would naturally alert the bodyguards. Why was there no movement at all?
"Could it be?"
Guo Xiaotian suddenly had an ominous premonition.
"That's right, I killed all those dogs outside, you see."
Chen Feng smiled slightly, and when he moved his hand, more than 20 fleshy and bloody things appeared on the smooth floor. Guo Xiaotian gasped when he saw it, because there were 20 bloody hearts on the floor, and the hearts were still beating.
It turned out that when Chen Feng came in just now, he was discovered by the patrolling Wukoutang boys. Chen Feng killed them with sword energy without talking to them and took out their hearts.
Chen Feng knew that these gangsters were not good guys and had done countless bad things, so he would not be polite in attacking them.
"Oh my God!"
In the hall of the villa, Guo Long was so frightened when he saw the heart on the ground that he felt his stomach churn. He turned around and vomited directly. The place was filled with a sour smell.
Seeing a pile of vomit on the ground and smelling the stench, Chen Feng looked away in disgust, thinking that such a waste was still a second-generation gangster, and he was still causing trouble everywhere.
Although Guo Long vomited, Guo Xiaotian and his elite men were fine. Of course, although they did not vomit, their expressions still changed.
Chen Feng, that’s too cruel.
As soon as he came in, he killed so many of his five cousins. , and even took out their hearts. This method was indeed ruthless, more ruthless than any of them.
"Brother, I can see that you should be a warrior. How about you join our Five Mouth Hall? As long as you join, your grudges with us will be wiped out. Then how about I give you a salary of 30 million yuan every month?"
But after Guo Xiaotian took a deep breath, a smile suddenly appeared on his face, and he looked at Chen Feng with bright eyes.
Naturally, Guo Xiaotian is also a man who loves money. When he saw that Chen Feng was so powerful and quietly killed 20 of his men, such a powerful person was naturally a warrior, and at least he had reached a small level of inner strength.
Such a person is a top-notch person even in the huge Wukou Hall.
So Guo Xiaotian wants to win over Chen Feng and do things for him.
You must know that although Wukou Hall is a group, it only has five heads. None of the five heads is convinced by the other. As the head of the fifth branch, Guo Xiaotian is actually the weakest of the five branches.
If he gets Chen Feng, his fifth branch will naturally become stronger.
"Dad, you are crazy, he is our enemy."
Hearing that his father wanted to win over Chen Feng, Guo Long was furious and thought that his father was crazy. For Guo Long, Chen Feng was his enemy and Chen Feng was bound to die, even if Chen Feng was very powerful.
"Shut up."
However, Guo Xiaotian just glared at his son, and then looked at Chen Feng expectantly.
"Oh, it's not impossible for me to join you, but I have a condition."
Chen Feng said with a smile.
"Oh, what are the conditions? As long as I can do it, I will definitely do it. Whether it requires more money or a beautiful woman, don't worry, we have both."
Seeing Chen Feng's conditions, Guo Xiaotian felt a lot more relieved. In his eyes, men were just looking for money and sex, and they could easily manipulate them if they had weaknesses.
If you are looking for money, their Wukoutang is the largest gang in Chuzhou, with annual profits of tens of billions, so they are naturally not short of money.
It would be even easier if they were talking about pictures. There were hundreds of them in Chuzhou alone.There were probably hundreds of thousands of beauties in the nightclub, so it was too easy to find a few top-notch ones to serve Chen Feng.
"Haha, Hall Master Guo, you also know that your son has offended me. He bullied my little aunt, and I have a deep relationship with my little aunt. How about if you castrate your son, I will join you."
Chen Feng said with a smile, and suddenly threw a knife to Guo Xiaotian, and the knife fell at Guo Xiaotian's feet.
Hearing Chen Feng's words and seeing the knife on the ground, Guo Xiaotian was stunned, Guo Long was stunned, and everyone present was stunned.
"Are you kidding me? How could I castrate my own son? Am I making myself sterile?"
Guo Xiaotian's face suddenly darkened. He knew that Chen Feng was just playing tricks on him. Who would castrate his son so that he could have no descendants?
